Amazon's cost of revenue (reported as "cost of sales") **rose about 36.5%** from fiscal Q1 2023 to fiscal Q4 2023.

| Quarter | Cost of sales | Basis |
|---|---|---|
| Q1 2023 | $67,791M | As I recall it from the Q1 2023 10-Q |
| Q2 2023 | $69,373M | As I recall it from the Q2 10-Q |
| Q3 2023 | $75,022M | As I recall it from the Q3 10-Q |
| FY 2023 | $304,739M | As I recall it from the 10-K |
| Q4 2023 | $92,553M | Derived: FY 2023 minus Q1–Q3 |

Change = (92,553 − 67,791) / 67,791 ≈ **+36.5%**

The Q4 figure is not a directly reported quarterly number. It depends on all four recalled figures being correct, and I have not checked them against the filings.
